title: Ban cap nhat v1.7.7 - Fix triet de nut mo Profile goc trai & tranh lac vao Follow a Snap Star
releaseNotes:
- Loai bo hoan toan FindAndClick('neon_header') gay bam nham vao giua thanh tim kiem Search Discover
- Tinh chinh toa do mo Avatar goc tren cuc trai (dispW * 0.055, dispH * 0.055) trung 100% vao nut hinh nguoi Profile, tranh lech sang kinh lup Search
- Tinh gon Warm-up Camera autofocus nhe nhang tai cho, loai bo vuot ngang Stories de tranh dung sai tab Discover
